info.name: TravelHues API
info.description:
Comprehensive API collection for TravelHues MVP. Base URL: http://localhost:3000/api/v1

Use the 'TravelHues Local' environment. After Login or Register the accessToken and refreshToken collection variables are auto-populated.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints — register, login, token refresh, password reset, email verification.

request.description: Register a new regular user account.
Register as a creator using a valid invite token. Auto-saves accessToken and refreshToken on success.
Login with email and password. Auto-saves accessToken and refreshToken on success.
Exchange a refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair.
Invalidate the current session. Requires authentication.
Get the authenticated user's details.
Check whether an invite token is valid before attempting creator registration.
Send a password-reset email to the specified address.
Reset the user's password using the token received via email.
Verify the user's email address using the token received via email.

item.name: 2. Admin
item.description: Admin-only endpoints for managing creator invites. Requires ADMIN role.

request.description: Generate a creator invite for the specified email address. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated list of creator invites. Filter by status: PENDING, USED, REVOKED. Requires ADMIN role.
Summary stats for all invites (total, pending, used, revoked). Requires ADMIN role.
Fetch a single invite record by its ID. Requires ADMIN role.
Permanently revoke an invite so it can no longer be used. Requires ADMIN role.
Retrieve the authenticated user's full profile.
Update the authenticated user's profile fields.
Permanently delete the authenticated user's account. This action is irreversible.
Submit an application to become a creator. Requires authentication.
Retrieve the authenticated creator's own profile.

item.name: 5. Destinations
item.description: Destination catalog — countries, regions, and cities.

request.description: Public paginated list of all destinations. Filter by type or continent.
List all top-level country destinations.
Fetch a single destination by its URL slug.
List reels and photos tagged to this destination.
List all purchasable products available at this destination.
List creators who have content or products at this destination.
List travel tips for this destination.

item.name: 6. Content (Reels & Photos)
item.description: Social content feed — upload, view, like, and comment on reels and photos.

request.description: Public paginated content feed. Filter by destination or content type.
Upload a new reel or photo. Requires CREATOR role.
Fetch a single content item with full details.
Update your own content item. Requires authentication and ownership.
Delete your own content item. Requires authentication and ownership.
Like a content item. Requires authentication.
Remove your like from a content item.
Paginated list of comments for a content item.
Post a comment on a content item. Set parentId to reply to an existing comment. Requires authentication.

item.name: 7. Tips
item.description: Long-form travel tips and guides written by creators.
